verses.12:72: قَالُواْ نَفۡقِدُ صُوَاعَ ٱلۡمَلِكِ وَلِمَن جَآءَ بِهِۦ حِمۡلُ بَعِيرࣲ وَأَنَا۠ بِهِۦ زَعِيمࣱ‏

meaning: The root صوع (SwE) primarily refers to a specific dry measure, the *ṣāʿ*, equal to four *amdad*. It can also denote a drinking vessel, especially the king's cup mentioned in the Quran (12:72).
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
